name: sign-in
title: Sign in
description: Email first, then a password, a passkey or a link by email.

name: sign-up
title: Create account
description: Three fields checked as you go, then a code by email to confirm the address.

name: reset-password
title: Reset password
description: The email, a code sent to it, then a new password.

name: split-sign-in
title: Split sign in
description: Email and password together on a frosted panel, beside the art.

name: orders
title: Orders
description: Search, filters, sorting and pages together; select rows and act on them, with every state.

name: catalogue
title: Catalogue
description: Products grouped by collection, each opening into its finishes, with stock to change in place.

name: overview
title: Overview
description: Four numbers against the period before, revenue over time, best sellers, latest orders and low stock.

name: analytics
title: Analytics
description: Revenue by collection, the path from visit to order, channels and cities.

name: status
title: Status
description: Every service in a word and a color, response time against its budget, and incidents as threads.

name: storefront
title: Storefront
description: The store's home: a hero over the art, the collections, the most listened to, and the figures.

name: collection
title: Collection
description: Every piece, a collection or a search, filtered and sorted from the address.

name: product
title: Product
description: Pictures that follow the finish and open large, stock in words, a quantity and one button to buy.

name: cart
title: Cart
description: Every piece with its quantity, removed with an undo, and every cost before checkout.

name: checkout
title: Checkout
description: One page, as a guest: express first, then contact, delivery and payment, with a summary that folds on a phone.

name: confirmation
title: Confirmation
description: Thanks by name, what happens next and when, the order, and an offer to save the details.

name: compare
title: Compare
description: Up to three pieces side by side, the first column pinned, with only the differences on request.

name: wishlist
title: Saved
description: Pieces kept for later in the finish chosen, with stock, one-click buying and a link to share the list.

name: account
title: Account
description: Orders with where each one is, addresses in a drawer, kept cards and details, a tab each.

name: order
title: Order
description: One order: where it is in a sentence and steps, tracking, what's in it, what happened, cancel or return.

name: returns
title: Returns
description: Sending something back in four steps: which pieces, why, how it travels and the refund, then the code to show.
